description:

title: Unfathomed
description:
S08 E02 — Abaco's Calling Pt. 2
Follow Capt. George in search of fish and adventure.

title: The Fish Guyz
description:
S06 E08 — Snackle Time
George and Lain stock up on much-needed supplies at Marathon Tackle; Capt. Bob Beighley guides the Guyz to an action-packed day catching bull sharks and cobia in the Gulf of Mexico; chef Cat shares her recipe for fish tacos.

title: Spear Life
description:
S04 E09 — Wallhanger Hogfish With the Martini Boys
Jon, Gary and Coby head back to one of their favorite places to dive, Myrtle Beach, South Carolina; by the end of the trip, three people break personal records; one person finally gets their wall-hanger hogfish they've been after for years.

description:

description:
S07 E02 — Giant Tuna Fishing in Cape Cod Bay
